gen-gf-gugi-manrope: Gugi's lowercase climbs almost to the height of its capitals, giving the heading a tall, blunt presence. And Manrope, with its bright open curves and sans-serif simplicity, makes the loudest strongest quality of the pair feel approachable.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-montserrat: Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders barely above the x-height, with terminals flicking outward in a loose, bold hand. Montserrat's generous curves glide along smoothly beneath it.
gen-gf-oxanium-switzer: Oxanium opens with a big, tall-lowercase swagger. It owns the shouting, while Switzer, a plain sans with wire-like tubular letters and tips that never close up, handles the quiet, steady talking.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-public-sans: Scattered, loud and oddly spacious, Paprika fills the line with lowercase that looks like capitals. But Public Sans, a plain sans with a hefty body and broad open counters, gives the pair its strongest quality: a grounded, trustworthy footing.
gen-gf-revalia-work-sans: Revalia stretches a tall band of letters across the line, with a lowercase g that leaves its lower curve open. Work Sans keeps it steady and modern.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono sets its letters like pins in a wide board, every curve as thick as its stems. And Goldman, with its widely spaced, parenthesis-round forms, gives the pair a bold, commanding contrast.
gen-dafont-azonix-fs-supreme: Tubular, wide-mouthed and stern, Azonix has strokes like thin plastic tubing bent into loops. Yet Supreme, a plain sans with a heavy, crisp strip of text, gives the pair its strongest quality: authority that stays legible.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-epilogue: Expressive from the first letter, Snowburst One looks like a stencil sheet with wide bridges between its tall lowercase. And Epilogue's curvy, wire-like sans letters sit under it with an unclamped, approachable ease.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-fs-public-sans: Bold tube-like strokes, a splayed c terminal and a large x-height give Tilt Neon a marker-drawn punch up top. Public Sans, a plain sans, simply does the steady, trustworthy work of the text.
gen-gf-unica-one-general-sans: Unica One's very large lowercase, with visible daylight inside every curve, is what you notice first. General Sans, a plain sans, joins it with a smooth, unobstructed line, making the pair's strongest quality a confident, steady pressure.
